description: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE [FACTORY OF] ACTIVE-CLASS (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2 general format, GR22 e)) — the reference is bound to "the same class as the object that was used to invoke the method in which this data description entry is specified". LIVE since kb/Work PB389: the descriptor carries the ACTIVE-CLASS kind and its containing class, the item emits that class's C# type, §2023:13.18.60.3 SR16 places it (COBOL1924), and §2023:14.9.39.3 SR12 b) / SR14 adjudicate it as a SET operand. ACTIVE-CLASS is a §2023:8.9 reserved word 2002+ and an ordinary user word at 85, so the token rides the cobolWord reservation funnel.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. UORAC.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM UORAC.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. UORACC.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
METHOD-ID. MK.
DATA DIVISION.
LOCAL-STORAGE SECTION.
01 A USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE ACTIVE-CLASS.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET A TO SELF.
END METHOD MK.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS UORACC.
